summary: First-finish latency test for KRIDANGAN. Public GET endpoints and frontend render correctly. CRITICAL BLOCKER: every POST endpoint and any handler that depends on the RateLimiter (submit_limiter / status_limiter / login_limiter) or declares a `request: Request` param fails with HTTP 422 — FastAPI is treating `request` as a required query parameter. This breaks admin login, registration submit, and status lookup end-to-end.
passed: GET /api/registration/config -> 200 with 3 games (freefire/chess/efootball), fee=null, fee_display='₹XXX', payment.upi_id='kridangan@upi', qr='/assets/payment-qr.png', organizer_email present
Frontend homepage loads at preview URL with KRIDANGAN hero, GAMES / PRIZE POOL / ABOUT / STATUS / CONTACT nav sections rendering, no console errors, no page errors

failed.issue: POST /api/registration/submit returns 422 {loc:['query','request'], msg:'Field required'} for ALL cases (valid multipart, invalid mobile, duplicate UTR, non-image). Cannot create any registration.
POST /api/registration/status returns 422 with same 'query.request missing' error even though the handler signature has no Request param — the error is injected by Depends(status_limiter).
POST /api/admin/login returns 422 with the same 'query.request missing' error for both correct and wrong credentials. Admin panel is entirely unreachable.
failed.evidence: curl -d '{"username":"admin@kridangan.local","password":"Kridangan@2026"}' /api/admin/login -> HTTP 422 detail=[{'loc':['query','request'],'msg':'Field required'}]. Bad creds also -> 422 (not 401).

failed.issue: GET /api/admin/me returns 401 for both cookie and no-cookie cases because login can never issue a cookie (dependent on login endpoint being broken).
failed.evidence: GET /api/admin/me with fresh cookie jar -> 401 'Admin authentication required'

action_items: Root cause: `from __future__ import annotations` (in /app/backend/lib/security.py and likely /app/backend/routers/*.py) stringifies annotations. FastAPI's dependency resolver on the RateLimiter class instance (Depends(submit_limiter/status_limiter/login_limiter)) then fails to recognise `request: Request` in RateLimiter.__call__, treating it as a required query field named 'request'. Same problem for handlers where `request: Request` is a direct parameter.

Suggested fixes (choose one): (a) Remove `from __future__ import annotations` from lib/security.py and any router that defines handlers with `request: Request` or Depends(<limiter>); (b) Instead of using a callable class instance as a dependency, wrap it in a plain async function (e.g., `async def submit_rate_limit(request: Request): submit_limiter(request)`) — plain functions resolve types via get_type_hints correctly even with future annotations; (c) In RateLimiter.__call__ signature, keep the runtime import of Request and avoid the future-annotations issue by defining the limiters in a module without `from __future__ import annotations`.

After fix, re-run: /api/registration/submit (valid + duplicate + bad-mime), /api/registration/status, /api/admin/login (good/bad), /api/admin/me, /api/admin/stats, /api/admin/registrations, approve/reject/note/export.csv, /api/admin/logout.
Unrelated: /assets/payment-qr.png 404 is expected per problem statement (not a bug).

success_rate.backend: 17% (2/12 endpoints reachable — only the two GETs without limiters/request work)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for homepage render (deeper flows blocked by backend)
